text: In the coming decades, artificial intelligence is set to transform our world in ways we are only beginning to imagine. While most current AI is "narrow," designed for specific tasks like language translation or image recognition, researchers are working toward artificial general intelligence, or AGI. This would be a machine with human-like reasoning and learning abilities across any domain. The potential benefits are enormous, from solving complex medical problems to tackling climate change. However, significant risks exist, including job displacement and ethical concerns about control. Most experts predict AGI could arrive within the next fifty years, though some believe it may take much longer. Either way, careful planning will be essential to ensure this powerful technology serves humanity.
